chapter.v:
How hast
thou helped him that is without power! How hast thou saved the arm that hath no strength!

How hast
thou counselled him that hath no wisdom, And plentifully declared sound knowledge!

To whom
hast thou uttered words? And whose spirit came forth from thee?

They that
are deceased tremble Beneath the waters and the inhabitants thereof.

Sheol is
naked before God, And Abaddon hath no covering.

He stretcheth
out the north over empty space, And hangeth the earth upon nothing.

He bindeth
up the waters in his thick clouds; And the cloud is not rent under them.

He incloseth
the face of his throne, And spreadeth his cloud upon it.

He hath
described a boundary upon the face of the waters, Unto the confines of light and darkness.

The pillars
of heaven tremble And are astonished at his rebuke.

He stirreth
up the sea with his power, And by his understanding he smiteth through Rahab.

By his
Spirit the heavens are garnished; His hand hath pierced the swift serpent.

Lo, these
are but the outskirts of his ways: And how small a whisper do we hear of him! But the thunder of his power who can understand?
